scripts.check-probe: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.readFileSync('probe.js','utf8')!==fs.readFileSync('extension/probe.js','utf8')){console.error('\u274c probe.js and extension/probe.js differ \u2014 run: npm run sync-probe');process.exit(1)}console.log('\u2713 probe.js in sync with extension')"
scripts.pretest: npm run check-probe && npm run check-glass
scripts.pack-extension: cp probe.js extension/probe.js && rm -f ui-match-extension.zip && cd extension && zip -r ../ui-match-extension.zip manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.js glass.js probe.js icons -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.test:accuracy: node planning/tools/accuracy-test.js && node planning/tools/real-figma-test/run.js && node planning/tools/real-figma-test/grade.js --assert
scripts.test:e2e: node qa/make-fixtures.mjs && node qa/e2e.mjs && node qa/e2e-extension.mjs
